reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents an informational promotional overview of IPEPE and describes exchange listings, events, and gameplay-related tokens. The referral-linked account and funding route are accompanied by disclosed affiliate compensation, an information-not-financial-advice framing, and advice to research before investing.

open an account fund your account with usdt go into the trade section and search i pepe when this token gets listed tomorrow at 11 a.m and then simply just buy the token
this token will be getting a very big central exchange listing starting tomorrow april 1st at 11 a.m utc time this token will be listed on MEXC global
there will be a ton of referral codes in the description box
Links above include affiliate commission or referrals. I'm part of an affiliate network and I receive compensation from partnering websites.

opening.argument: Judge the reward claim together with the action required to pursue it. Viewers are told they can get “free money,” rewards, or crypto by using referral codes and funding an account. That is not merely a description of an app: the advertised benefit is tied to registration and putting money into an account. The speaker also acknowledges that the referral route benefits him. The disclaimer does not remove the promise-action link at the center of this solicitation.

citations.quote: you can get yourself free money free rewards free Crypto things like that just by using those referral codes down there and funding your Account
Referral codes benefit both of us

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense calls this an informational overview, but its own quoted account-and-funding route ends with an instruction to buy. Disclosing affiliate compensation clarifies the speaker’s incentive; it does not change what viewers are asked to do to pursue the advertised rewards.

citations.quote: open an account fund your account with usdt go into the trade section and search i pepe when this token gets listed tomorrow at 11 a.m and then simply just buy the token
Links above include affiliate commission or referrals. I'm part of an affiliate network and I receive compensation from partnering websites.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quoted rewards are described broadly as referral benefits, not as a guaranteed payout for funding an account. The speaker explicitly says referrals benefit both parties and advises viewers to research before investing. Those facts support a disclosed promotion, while the prosecution’s quotes do not establish a false offer, withheld reward, or deceptive transaction.

opening.argument: Look at the combined pressure, not any single phrase. The speaker presents a 30,000 USDT reward pool and a chance to win free airdrops by committing exchange tokens, then gives a voting window ending the next morning. Signup bonuses, a token commitment, and a short deadline make the reward pitch more consequential than a passing mention of market news. The judge should weigh that time-limited asset-acquisition invitation against the cautionary language elsewhere in the video.

citations.quote: it says you a pool of 30,000 U S DT. So exclusive future bonuses on a sign up
Users can commit MX tokens. So that's MEXC globals token to participate in the event and win free airdrops.
the voting period is March 31st today at 9 a.m utc time until april 1st 8 50 a.m utc time

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense points to a listing and an affiliate disclosure, but neither resolves the separate event pitch. The speaker says users can commit MX tokens for a chance at free airdrops and identifies an imminent participation window. That is an invitation to act on a reward claim, not simply a report that a token exists.

citations.quote: Users can commit MX tokens. So that's MEXC globals token to participate in the event and win free airdrops.
the voting period is March 31st today at 9 a.m utc time until april 1st 8 50 a.m utc time

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The event is described with participation conditions, including limits based on a user’s MX balance, and the speaker directs viewers to check the event’s details and eligibility. A stated event window and reward pool do not by themselves show that the event is fictitious or that any viewer is guaranteed an airdrop.

there's all sorts of details and participation eligibility that you can check out on ME-XC for this event.

opening.argument: The presentation may begin as token information, but it becomes a purchase funnel. The speaker emphasizes a next-day exchange listing, offers his referral route for opening and funding an account, and tells viewers to search for IPEPE and buy it when trading begins. Calling this an overview understates how directly the listing news is used to steer participation. The purchase instruction is the point the judge should weigh, especially alongside the speaker’s disclosed compensation from referral links.

open an account fund your account with usdt go into the trade section and search i pepe when this token gets listed tomorrow at 11 a.m and then simply just buy the token
Links above include affiliate commission or referrals. I'm part of an affiliate network and I receive compensation from partnering websites.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that the speaker discusses the listing and discloses affiliate compensation. Those points also show why this is more than detached analysis: the listing supplies the timing, while the referral-linked instructions supply the route from account creation and funding to purchase. A disclaimer does not erase that sequence.

citations.quote: open an account fund your account with usdt go into the trade section and search i pepe when this token gets listed tomorrow at 11 a.m and then simply just buy the token
Links above include affiliate commission or referrals. I'm part of an affiliate network and I receive compensation from partnering websites.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is promotional, but promotion alone does not establish a scam. The speaker supplies a concrete exchange-trading route, discloses referral compensation, and expressly says he is not telling viewers to buy. The prosecution identifies no quoted promise of appreciation, dividend, or holding return tied to purchasing IPEPE.
